per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prefer availability for search results over strict real-time consistency; when upstream feeds are unavailable show last-known-good cached data and visibly mark data age.
A reconciliation pipeline must revalidate cached parts during estimate finalization and produce auditable records of any post-hoc changes.

Every part suggestion use or override, estimate submission, parts assignment, facility assignment, and facility rating must produce a persisted, auditable event (user, timestamp, change) shipped to corporate analytics and long-term storage.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: High-volume diagnostic traces may be sampled, but semantic audit events must always be persisted; logging shall be asynchronous to avoid blocking critical paths.

The application must implement tenant isolation at application and data layers (e.g., tenant-aware queries and row-level security), with role-based access controls and tenant-scoped encryption keys where feasible.
Identity provider must assert tenant information in issued tokens so every service call can enforce authorization.
The system shall implement rate limiting, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation at the application level and use WAF/DDoS protections at the perimeter to defend in depth.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Leverage corporate perimeter defenses and cloud provider DDoS/WAF services, but ensure the application maintains its own protective controls.

Adopt the corporate approved service mesh, logging/tracing standards, identity platform, and UI component/accessibility guidelines; deviation is not allowed for core components.
